channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Crusoe Signs Roughly $13 Billion AI Cloud Deal With Jane Street
item.description: Crusoe, a data center upstart with contracts to supply AI computing power to the likes of Meta Platforms Inc. and Oracle Corp., has signed a cloud contract with trading firm Jane Street Group valued at around $13 billion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Torrence and Dina Bass

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 Astra Model With Added Cyber Guardrails
item.description: OpenAI is releasing a new generation of its technology called GPT-6 that the company is positioning as a key milestone in its decade-long push to build so-called artificial general intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Metz

item.title: Elite Public High Schools To Get a Taste of Trump’s College Crusade
item.description: The Trump administration is scrutinizing some of the country’s most elite public high schools over whether their admissions practices discriminate based on race.
item.dc:creator: Liam Knox and Erin Hudson

item.title: Nvidia Buys Hugging Face | Open Interest 9/3/2026
item.description: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Nvidia makes another massive AI bet, striking a nearly $13 billion deal for Hugging Face. Blackstone caps private-credit redemptions again, while Elliott takes aim at Deutsche Telekom’s T-Mobile strategy. Plus, Matchroom Chairman Eddie Hearn reveals the location of the Fury-Joshua battle and his next big US expansion. And BWH Hotels CEO Larry Cuculic joins us on shifting travel demand, rising costs and the World Cup boost. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Spending Ripples Across Tech Stack; Nvidia Acquires Hugging Face | Bloomberg Tech 9/03/2026
item.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what earnings from Broadcom, Snowflake, and HPE tell us about the strength of the AI boom. Plus, Hugging Face co-founder Thomas Wolf joins to discuss Nvidia's $13 billion acquisition deal for the AI startup, And, self-driving tech startup Wayve reaches a deal with Uber to offer robotaxi rides in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Fuels Snowflake’s Accelerating Revenue Growth
item.description: Snowflake posted a third straight quarter of accelerating product revenue growth and raised its full-year outlook, with CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy saying AI accounted for about half of the company’s outperformance. He discusses the rapid adoption of Snowflake’s AI coding agent Coco, growing customer usage, and how the company is competing with Databricks in the race to turn enterprise data into AI-driven growth. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Wayve, Uber Bring Robotaxi Rides to London
item.description: Self-driving startup Wayve is launching robotaxi rides with Uber in London, initially with safety drivers behind the wheel. CEO Alex Kendall discusses the path to fully driverless service, plans to expand with Uber to more global cities, and how Wayve’s end-to-end AI technology is designed to drive without relying on high-definition maps. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Snowflake Jumps on Revenue Outlook, Uptake of AI Assistant
item.description: Snowflake shares jumped by the most in three months after the company raised its outlook for annual sales and touted rapid adoption of its AI-assisted coding tool. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Tech Analyst Matt Bloxham discusses the outlook from Snowflake as well as Broadcom's AI chip forecast and Nvidia's move to buy Hugging Face. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Pentagon Says Its Anthropic Ban Is On, Despite Lutnick Remarks
item.description: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said Anthropic PBC has resolved its long-running issues with the Trump administration but a top Pentagon official begs to differ.
item.dc:creator: Maggie Eastland

item.title: HPE CEO Neri on Oracle Deal, AI Adoption and Earnings Outlook
item.description: HPE President and CEO Antonio Neri discusses the benefits of HPE's networking deal with Oracle and the company's earnings outlook. Speaking with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech," Neri says he is seeing "huge growth" in enterprise AI adoption. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Why Hugging Face Decided to Combine With Nvidia
item.description: Hugging Face co-founder Thomas Wolf discusses the impetus for Nvidia's agreement to acquire the artificial intelligence startup in a transaction valued at about $13 billion. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceXAI Hit by Outages for AI Models
item.description: OpenAI, Anthropic PBC and SpaceXAI were hit by outages on Thursday, according to user reports and company status pages, disrupting customers of three of the leading US AI model makers.
item.dc:creator: Seth Fiegerman

item.title: EU Risks Falling Further Behind US, China, Ireland’s Martin Says
item.description: Europe needs a change in mindset on innovation and technology and must take bolder action or it will fall further behind economic powerhouses like the US and China, according to Ireland’s prime minister.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Fletcher, Suzanne Lynch and Jennifer Duggan

item.title: Senate Considers Letting Contractors Hack Computers for Military
item.description: Contractors would be allowed to conduct military hacking operations with US government approval under a Senate defense bill that would mark the first time Congress has explicitly authorized the private sector to conduct offensive cyber missions.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Howell O'Neill

item.title: DeepMind’s New AI Weather Model Goes Hourly for Power Markets
item.description: The newest AI weather model from Google DeepMind not only forecasts how hard the wind blows at turbine height and how much sunlight reaches a solar farm, but refreshes those projections every hour from satellite images.
item.dc:creator: Joe Wertz

item.title: Chipmaker Longsys Said to Price Hong Kong Listing at HK$236
item.description: Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co. priced its Hong Kong listing below the top end of the marketed range, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a wave of Chinese companies along the artificial intelligence supply chain to debut in the city.
item.dc:creator: Julia Fioretti and Sangmi Cha

item.title: Saudi AI Firm Humain Unveils Model Based on China’s MiniMax
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s artificial intelligence company Humain has built a national AI platform based on an open model from Chinese lab MiniMax Group Inc., joining a growing list of countries seeking tighter control of the increasingly important technology.
item.dc:creator: Luz Ding and Zheping Huang

item.title: Nvidia to Buy Hugging Face for $13 Billion in Open-Source Push
item.description: Nvidia Corp. agreed to acquire artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face in a transaction valued at about $13 billion, adding a popular software platform to the chip giant’s AI empire.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gould, Ian King and Rachel Metz

item.title: Chevron CEO Says Patience Pays Off in Venezuela Oil Deal
item.description: Big Oil has often employed the “hang around” playbook: secure legal rights to a giant resource — and then, eventually, figure out how to produce it profitably. But few companies have taken it to the extremes of Chevron Corp.
item.dc:creator: Kevin Crowley

item.title: HPE Slides After Sales Boost Misses Highest Expectations
item.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. shares declined after the company’s sales growth failed to meet the lofty expectations of investors, who had seen the stock price more than double this year.
item.dc:creator: Dina Bass and Ed Ludlow
